If the issue persists, users may need to consult the device manufacturer’s support resources or visit a professional repair service for further assistance.

## What are the common causes of screen brightness adjustment issues? [...] The most common causes of screen brightness adjustment issues include outdated or corrupted graphics drivers, incorrect display settings, and hardware problems with the display or backlight. Additionally, conflicts with other system settings or third-party software can also prevent the screen brightness from being adjusted properly. In some cases, the issue may be due to a simple setting or configuration that has been overlooked, such as a stuck or disabled brightness adjustment slider. [...] Conflicts with other system settings or software can indeed cause screen brightness issues, as they can override or interfere with the display settings. For example, some software applications or system settings may automatically adjust the screen brightness or override the user’s settings, causing the issue. Additionally, conflicts with other system settings, such as power management or display calibration, can also prevent the screen brightness from being adjusted properly.
